tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu'i bsdus don khog phub 'jam dpal dges pa'i mchod sprin gsar pa'i me tog bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan sad+gu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya tri ṇi ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs dang bde 'byung mig stong pa la sogs/ /'jig rten che dgu'i gtsug gi nyer brten pa'i/ /ston mchog thub dbang zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /mi phyed dad pas lan brgyar phyag bgyi 'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid 'od zhags rings/ /bskal bzang yid mtshor sprul pa'i zlos gar ni/ /'jigs bral mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu yongs rdzogs gter/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan rgyal/ /de gsung phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal sras mo/ /zhu 'phrin dad pa'i pho nya 'dod gsal gyi/ /yi ge dam pa'i chos kun gzugs can bzhin/ /bkod 'di'i bsdus don brjod la bdag blo spro/ /zhes mchod brjod dang dam bca' sngon du btang nas/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig ces bya ba'i bsdus don 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi don dngos/ don de ldan gyi bstan bcos kyi mjug don dang gsum/ dang po bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag la/ mchod par brjod cing zhu ba dam bca' ba dang / ston pa sangs rgyas la bye brag tu mchod par brjod pa/ zhu ba'i mtshams sbyar ba dang gsum gyi/ dang po mchod par brjod cing zhu ba dam bca' ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba dang ldan gzhan la phan dgongs shes bya kun la bsgribs pa dang bral ye shes mnga'/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag nye bar zhi la lhun gyis grub par dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'phrin las can/

/gang zhig rtag tu phongs pa kun skyobs 'jig rten spyod pa dag las rnams grol ba/ /gsol ba btab na bslu med dang ldan rgyal dang de sras rnams la 'phrin 'di zhu/ zhes pas bstan/ ༈ /gnyis pa ston pa sangs rgyas la bye brag tu mchod par brjod pa ni/ bde byed tshangs dbang ltar bcas 'jig rten gyis/ /gang gi snyan pa sa gsum rab bsgrags pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa zhu ba'i mtshams sbyar ba ni/ swasti thugs rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan/ /'jig rten mngon sum gzigs pa la/ /mgon po bdag ni zhu bar 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi don dngos la/ sngon 'gro'i zhu ba/ dngos gzhi'i zhu ba/ rjes kyi zhu ba dang gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro'i zhu ba la yang / sngon 'byung ston pa'i mdzad pa smos pa/ rjes 'jug gang zag gi ji ltar dpyad pa'i tshul/ sa paṇa rang nyid kyi bstan pa la bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po sngon byung ston pa'i mdzad pa smos pa la yang / dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing tshogs bsags pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul/ chos la brten nas dge 'dun 'dus tshul/ bstan la gtad de mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing tshogs bsags tshul ni/ khyed kyis dang por byang chub thugs/ /gzhan gyi don slad kho nar bskyed/ /der rjes brtson pas grangs med gsum/ /lus dang srog la ltos med bsgrubs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul ni/ de nas byang chub snying por khyod/ /byang chub dam pa brnyes mdzad de/ /rnam grol chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rmad byung dam par rab bskor nas/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa chos la brten nas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'dus tshul ni/

de ni khyod kyi dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun bsdus te/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa bstan pa gtad de sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa ni/ nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur na/ /chos 'di khyod kyi ston pa yin/ /de nas tshig don ma nyams par/ /nga yi bstan pa zungs shig ces/ /sras kyi mchog la gtad mdzad de/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i bstan pa yang / /sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la gtad/ /de yi sgrubs pa'i bya ba kun/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten gtso bo dang / /sbyin bdag stobs can thams cad la/ /nan tan gyis ni legs gtad nas/ /mgon po mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa rjes 'jug gang zag gi ji ltar spyad pa'i tshul la/ legs par spyad pa'i tshul dang / log par spyad pa'i tshul gnyis kyi/ /dang po legs par spyad pa'i tshul ni/ de rjes 'phags pa'i gang zag dang / /so so skye bo mkhas pa dang / /chos rgyal rnams dang sbyin bdag ni/ /stobs ldan dad pa can rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gus pas bskyangs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa log par spyad pa'i tshul la yang / /'phags yul du ji ltar byung tshul dang / bod yul du ji ltar byung tshul gnyis/ dang po 'phags yul du ji ltar byung tshul ni/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di na/ /thub pa'i bstan pa phal cher nub/ /chos mngon mdzod las gsungs pa ltar/ /ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa dkrugs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar byung tshul la yang / sgrub pa'i bstan pa la ji ltar byung tshul dang / lung gi bstan pa la ji ltar byung tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po sgrub pa'i bstan pa la ji ltar byung tshul ni/ khyad par du yang byang phyogs kyi/ /kha ba can gyi bstan pa 'di/ /ngan rtog mun pas rnam par khyab/ /dge sbyong phal cher thos pa nyung / /sdom brtson phal cher bkur ba nyung / /bkur ba de dag sdom brtson nyung / /sbyin bdag chos la dad pa nyung /

/dad pa can gyi mchod cha dman/ /mchod pa de dag log 'tsho'i rgyu/ /gal lte log 'tsho mi za ba'i/ /chos byed de dag dman dman 'dra/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa lung gi bstan pa la ji ltar byung tshul la yang / bka' la byung tshul dang / bstan bcos la byung tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po bka' la byung tshul ni/ sangs rgyas bstan la dad na yang / /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab ngo mtshar can/ /de dag gzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin 'dor/ /blun po rnams kyi rdzun tshig la/ /thub pa'i bka' bas gus par 'dzin/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bstan bcos la byung tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub dang / /thogs med dang ni dbyig gi gnyen/ /phyogs kyi glang po chos grags sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /'phags pa lha sogs grub thob kyi/ /gsung rab yin par nges pa rnams/ /dug bzhin 'bad pas spangs nas ni/ /skyes bu rdzun mas sbyar ba yi/ /log rtog rnams la cher 'bad nas/ /grub thob rnams kyi gsung yin zhes/ /blun po rnams la rgyas par byed/ /'jig rten shes rab ldan pa dkon/ /bsod nams ldan pa shin tu nyung / /des na dam chos rin po che/ /khyed kyi gsung rab 'dzin pa dkon/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa sa paṇa rang nyid kyi bstan pa la bya ba ji ltar mdzad tshul la/ sngon du sbyang pa mdzad tshul dang / /chos dag ma dag gi rnam dbye mdzad tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po sngon du sbyang pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar shes na shākya yi/ /bstan pa nub par dgongs pa dang / /gzhan la phan par bsam nas ni/ /lung dang rig pa phal cher sbyangs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa chos dag ma dag gi rnam dbye mdzad tshul ni/ de yi stobs kyis chos kyi gnad/ /'khrul pa dang ni ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rnam gzhag cung zad bdag gis go /zhes pas bstan/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i zhu ba la/ /spyir zhu ba dang /

so sor zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po spyir zhu ba ni/ 'di la rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /mkhas pa sde snod 'dzin pa dang / /grub pa bsnyems pa'i skyes bu mchog /mngon sum gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /de dag kun ni dpang po lags/ /des na bdag gi 'thad mi 'thad/ /re zhig gsan par mdzad du gsol/ /khyed kyi gsung las 'di skad 'byung / /dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /yongs su brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ /zhes gsung gzhan yang mdo sde las/ /bstod 'os dmad par mi bya zhing / /dmad 'os bstod par mi bya zhes/ /gsung pa de yi yid la bzhag /slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas kyis/ /dad pa med pa gtso bo'i dgra/ /lhag dad shin tu gol ba'i gnas/ /gang phyir kun mkhyen tshad mas grub/ /grub pas kun mkhyen 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsung de yang bden par rtogs/ /de bzhin sde snod thams cad dang / /bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ /'khrul pa thams cad 'bad pas bkag /ma 'khrul ba rnams bsgrubs par mngon/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bskyangs 'dod nas/ /bdag kyang de yi rjes 'brangs te/ /chos kyi rnam dbye cung zad byas/ /de la blo gros ldan pa yi/ /sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher dga'/ /thog med blo gros bral ba yi/ /chags sdang can rnams phal cher dmod/ /bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs su gsol/ /gal te log par smra na ni/ /khyed rnams kyis kyang bdag la khrel/ /'on te bden par smra na ni/ /khyed kyis bdag la dges par mdzod/ /sgra tshad sdebs sbyor snyan dngags dang / /tshig rgyan ming gi nges brjod sogs/ /shin tu mkhas pa rnams la grags/ /sde snod gsum po de sbyangs pa'i/ /sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis mkhyen/ /rgyud sde bzhi po dag shes pa'i/ /rgyud sde 'dzin rnams mkhyen par gsal/ /rang rang gzhung dang mthun na yin/

/mi mthun pa de zab na yang / /sangs rgyas gsung dang ma 'brel phyir/ /mu stegs byed kyi zab par 'gyur/ /rnam dbye 'di ltar 'thad mi 'thad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi legs par dgongs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa so sor zhu ba la yang / rig gnas thun mong ba la zhu ba dang / nang don rig pa la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po rig gnas thun mong ba la zhu ba la yang / sgra la zhu ba/ sdeb sbyor la zhu ba/ rgyan dang mngon brjod la zhu ba/ tshad ma rig pa la zhu ba dang bzhi yi/ dang po sgra la zhu ba ni/ sgra la yi ge ming dang tshig /ngag dang rab tu byed pa sogs/ /chos kyi phung po'i bar du yang / /tshig bzang ba dang don gling ba/ /bden pa dang ni snyan pa sogs/ /yon tan kun ldan thub pas gsung / /yi ge la ni ring thung dang / /shin tu ring dang thug rkyang dang / /drag zhan dang ni lci yang dang / /u tad a nu ra ta sogs/ /bod la grags pa med mod kyi/ /phal cher dag pa shin tu nyung / /de la bdag gis ring thung sogs/ /rnam dbye sgra dang mthun par bgyi/ /de la sgra sbyor mi shes pa/ /phal cher bdag la dga' bar 'dzin/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sdeb sbyor la zhu ba ni/ sdeb sbyor la ni lci yang dang / /ngal gso'i gnas sogs gzhung lugs dang / /legs par bstun nas bkod pa la/ /sdeb sbyor med rnams the tshom za/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa rgyan dang mngon brjod la zhu ba ni/ tshig gi rgyan dang mngon brjod sogs/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung dang mthun par byas/ /de la blun po rgyab kyis phyogs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa tshad ma la zhu ba ni/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dbye bsdu dang / /mngon sum rjes su dpag pa la/ /snang ba dang ni sel ba dang / /'brel pa dang ni 'brel med sogs/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i 'jug tshul la/ /lung dang rig pa mi 'gal zhing / /chos kyi grags pa'i sde bdun ltar/ /bdag gis legs par brjod pa la/ /tshad ma ltar snang smra rnams rgol/

/zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa nang don rig pa la zhu ba la/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba la zhu ba dang / bstan pa'i yang snying phar phyin theg pa la zhu ba/ bstan pa'i nying khu rdo rje theg pa la zhu ba dang gsum gyi/ dang po bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba la zhu ba ni/ khyod kyi 'dul ba'i sde snod la/ /bsdud mdzad phyi mas sde pa bzhi/ /skad rigs rnam pa bzhi dag gis/ /'dul ba lung rnams sde bzhir bsdus/ /de la sde pa bco brgyad kyis/ /gnang bkag mi 'dra sna tshogs gsung / /dang po len pa'i cho ga dang / /bar du bsrung ba'i gnang bkag dang / /tha mar sdom pa gtong tshul dang / /byin rlabs dang ni phyir bcos pa'i/ /cho ga'i bye brag thams cad la/ /sde pa bzhi po mi 'dra ba'i/ /rnam par dbye ba du ma mthong / /pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi/ /theg pa'i rim pa'i dbye ba yi/ /sems can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /gnang bkag dbye ba du ma gnang / /de dag bdag gis lung bzhin bshad/ /de dag lung dang 'gal ba yi/ /ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba/ /'dod pa de dag bdag la gshe/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bstan pa'i snying po phar phyin theg pa la zhu ba la yang / sems bskyed pa dang / bslab bya la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po sems bskyed la zhu ba ni/ don dam zhes bya'i byang chub sems/ /chos nyid kyi ni thob ces gsung / /cho ga gzhung las bshad pa med/ /de skad bdag gis bshad pa la/ /chags sdang yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ /kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las/ /skyed phyir brda las byung bar gsung / /de la nyan thos theg chen gnyis/ /nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la/ /sems bskyed cho ga tha dad yod/ /theg chen pa la sems tsam dang / /dbu ma'i sems bskyed rnam gnyis snang / /bdag gi de dag phye ste bshad/ /de la sde snod mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo phal cher bdag la rgol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bslab bya la zhu ba ni/ de yi bslab par bya ba'i chos/

/bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs pa la/ /'jig rten pa rnams bzhad gad byed/ /de yi bslab bya'i chos gzhan yang / /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bdag gis sgrubs/ /'di la'ang bden par 'dzin pa dka'/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa rdo rje theg pa la zhu ba la/ dngos dang / zhar byung tshig la zhu ba gnyis/ dang po dngos la yang / spyir zhu ba dang / so sor zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po spyir zhu ba ni/ deng sang sngags la mos pa mang / /gsang sngags slob pa shin tu nyung / /blo gsal rnams kyis 'bad na yang / /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa shes dka' na/ /blun po ma bslab pa rnams kyis/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ga la shes/ /dang po mkhas pa mi bsten par/ /phyis nas slob ma bsdud pa mthong / /de yi stobs kyis gsang sngags la/ /nor pa'i rnam gzhag du ma mthong / /bdag gis bshad pa bden mi bden/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gsan du gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa so sor zhu ba la yang / smin byed dbang la zhu ba/ 'phral gyi lag len dang bslab bya la zhu ba/ grol byed rim pa gnyis la zhu ba/ ye shes phyag chen po la zhu ba/ sa lam gyi rnam gzhag la zhu ba dang lnga/ dang po smin byed dbang la zhu ba la/ gsang sngags bsgom pa la dbang bskur nges par dgos tshul/ dbang bskur ba la cho ga rnam par dag pa dgos tshul/ byin rlabs phra mo tsam smin byed kyi dbang bskur ma yin par bstan pa/ rang bzo'i phag mo'i smin byed mi 'thad par bstan pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po gsang sngags bsgom pa la dbang bskur nges par dgos tshul ni/ gal te gsang sngags mi sgom na/ dbang bskur med kyang 'gal ba med/ /gsang sngags sgom la mos gyur na/ /ci nas dbang bskur dgos par gsung / /phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med pa 'chad byed pa/

/slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyi/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsung rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ /dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs pa ni/ /shi nas ngu 'bod chen por lhung / /zhes gsungs dam pa dang po las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /sngags kyi de nyid bsgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin rgyud gzhan dang / /bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ /dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ /de yis gsang sngags sgom par gsungs/ /de skad khyod kyis gsungs pa yi/ /dgongs pa bdag gis bshad pa la/ /rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams rgol/ /cung zad shes kyang ma go ba'i/ /blun po rnams kyang bdag la gshe /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la cho ga rnam par dag pa dgos tshul la/ 'phral gyi lag len la zhu ba dang / bslab bya dam tshig la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po 'phral gyi lag len la zhu ba ni/ de yang blo ldan legs bslab pa/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon ni/ /dbang bskur mdzad pa nyung bar snang / /blun po cho ga mi shes pa/ /de dag rmongs pa'i tshogs bsdus nas/ /slob ma brgya stong du ma la/ /sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga kun/ /nyams pa'i dbang bskur byed pa thos/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bslab bya dam tshig la zhu ba ni/ de yi sngags dang ting 'dzin dang / /cho ga'i khyad par thams cad la/ /khyod kyi gsung dang mthun pa med/ /de la dngos grub ci ltar mchi/ /khyod kyi gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /khyad par can gyi las rnams la/ /lha dus bya ba dus bzhin spyad/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /de la sogs pa'i gsung gi ni/ /cho ga cung zad 'khrul pa la'ang / /dngos grub 'byung bar ma gsung na/

/deng sang thams cad 'khrul pa la/ /dngos grub 'dod pa bdud kyis bslus/ /de slad bdag gis cho ga kun/ /dag par bshad la khro ba mang / /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa byin rlabs phra mo tsam smin byed kyi dbang bskur ma yin par bstan pa ni/ kha cig phag mo'i byin rlabs dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang / /gtor ma'i dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /brdzun mas sbyar ba'i cho ga la/ /blun po 'jug pa smos ci dgos/ /sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yi/ /snying med rnams kyang 'di la dad/ /'di 'dra gal te chos yin na/ /de las chos min gang zhig lags/ /mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsung / /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa rang bzo'i phag mo'i smin byed mi 'thad par bstan pa ni/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab/ /phag mo'i dbang gis smin ces zer/ /gang zag rab 'bring thams cad la/ /phag mo'i smin byed bshad pa med/ /gal te yod na khyed nyid dpang / /las chog mgo la bzhag pa yis/ /dge slong 'gyur zhes zer ba dang / /khyim pas mkhan slob byas pa la/ /bsnyen rdzogs 'byung zhes zer ba thos/ /'di la mkhas rnams bzhad gad byed/ /phag mo'i dbang bskur la sogs la/ /deng sang bzhad gad byed pa med/ /gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni/ /de 'dra'i rab byung cho ga dang / /de 'dra'i dbang bskur bshad pa med/ /de dag gnyis ka 'khrul pas na/ /dam pa rnams kyis 'di ma byed/ /de 'dra'i log rtog bkag pa la/ /chags sdang can rnams bdag la rgol/ /bdag gis smras pa bden mi bden/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa 'phral gyi lag len dang bslab bya la zhu ba la yang / rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs la zhu ba dang / /rgyud sde'i lag len phan tshun 'chol bar spyod pa la zhu ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan ma 'bri tshul la zhu ba/ cho ga thams cad ma 'khrul bar byed dgos par gdams pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs la zhu ba ni/

gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /ro sreg dang ni bdun tshigs dang / /bar do dang ni 'pho ba dang / /dmigs pa'i bye brag mang po la/ /da lta'i cho ga byed pa rnams/ /phal cher khyed kyi gsung dang 'gal/ /lhag chad nor pa mang po mthong / /de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gnod par bsam nas bdag gis bkag /de la'ang mdo rgyud la sdang zhing / /bla ma ngan la gus pa yi/ /blun po phal cher bdag la dmod/ /'di la'ang bdag tshig bden mi bden/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa rgyud sde'i lag len phan tshun 'chol bar spyod pa la zhu ba ni/ rgyud sde bzhi po'i lag len yang / /deng sang 'chol par spyod pa mang / /don yod zhags pa la sogs pa'i/ /cho ga bya ba'i rgyud kyi yin/ /de la rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rim gnyis la sogs sbyor ba mthong / /de bzhin rgyud sde gzhan la yang / /cho ga 'chol par byed pa mang / /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan ma 'bri la zhu ba ni/ dges rdor bde mchog la sogs la/ /dbus kyi gtso bo yul phyung nas/ /mi yi gzugs brnyan 'jog pa mthong / /sangs rgyas sku la sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyong byed 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /mi yi lus la rten 'brel med/ /gal te bla ma sangs rgyas nyid/ /yin na sangs rgyas sku yi mchog /min na sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul/ /phyung nas mi yi gzugs 'jog pa/ /sdig pa'i sa bon mi lci 'am/ /'di 'dra'i lag len phyin ci log /ma bkag na ni bstan la gnod/ /bkag na gzhan gyi sems la gzan/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa cho ga thams cad ma 'khrul bar byed dgos par gdams pa ni/ gsung rab tshad mar mi byed na/ /dge slong dang ni dbang bskur la/ /sogs pa'i cho ga ci zhig dgos/ /gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni/ /dbang bskur la sogs cho ga rnams/ /mdo rgyud bzhin du cis mi byed/

/'ga' zhig 'khrul par shes bzhin du/ /bsnyen bskur 'dod pa'i bsams pa yi/ /cho ga thams cad 'khrul pa nyid/ /byed pa bdud kyis bslus pa yin/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa la/ /nor pa'i rnam gzhag mang po mthong / /de dag bkag pa'ang khro ba mang / /'on kyang khyed nyid dpang po lags/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa grol byed rim gnyis la zhu ba la yang / thun mong du zhu ba dang / so sor zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po thun mong du zhu ba ni/ bcom ldan khyod kyis gsang sngags lam/ /rim pa gnyis su bsdus te gsungs/ /de la rim gnyis mi dgos zhes/ /gsang sngags bsgom pa phal cher sgrogs/ /de dag khyod kyi gsung gis bkag /de la'ang de yi rigs can khro/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa so sor zhu ba la/ bskyed rim la zhu ba dang / rdzogs rim la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po bskyed rim la zhu ba ni/ bskyed rim sgom pa phal cher yang / /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag mi shes pa'i/ /rang bzo'i dkrongs bskyed sgom pa mthong / /bskyed rim gsal ba rab kyi mthar/ /gson po'i gang zag yang rab kyis/ /rdzogs rim gtso bor sbyong ba'i tshe/ /dkrongs bskyed gsung kyi da lta min/ /dper na kha zas dkrongs bskyed la/ /sngon du 'tshog chas mi dgos sam/ /sngon du tshogs sbyor mi bsgom pa'i/ /bar chad med lam dkrongs bskyed dang / /sa bcu rim gyis ma bgrod par/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par 'jug pa mi srid bzhin/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa ma sbyangs pa'i/ /lha bsgom dkrongs bskyed de dang 'dra/ /cho ga bzhin du sngags bzlas na/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /cho ga med na sngags bzang yang / /bzlos pa dgos pa chung bar gsungs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa rdzogs rim la zhu ba ni/ rnam dag tshul bzhin shes pa yis/ /gtum mo ye shes skye ba'i thabs/ /rnam dag med pa'i gtum mo ni/

/drod tsam skye yi ye shes min/ /drod skye ba yi gtum mo ni/ /mu stegs lugs yin nged kyi min/ /de bzhin rlung dang 'khrul 'khor sogs/ /mu stegs byed dang sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rnam gzhag mtshungs pa 'dra ba yod/ /gser dang ra gan 'byed pa la/ /'dris pa med na phye ba dka'/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa ye shes phyag chen la zhu ba la/ rtogs byed phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la zhu ba dang / rtogs bya spros bral gyi lta ba la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po rtogs byed phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la zhu ba la yang / rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos gzung ba dang / gzhan lugs kyi phyag chen dgag pa gnyis kyi/ dang po rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos gzung ba ni/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa yang / /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /rim gnyis ting 'dzin khyad par can/ /yin zhes khyod kyi gsung las 'byung / /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa gzhan lugs kyi phyag chen dgag pa la/ phyogs snga bkod pa dang / de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po phyogs snga bkod pa ni/ /kha cig dkar po chig thub la/ /phyag rgya chen po ngo spros byed/ /shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum/ /spangs la snyug ma bsgom par bya/ /bram ze skud pa 'khal ba ltar/ /so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /'di la phyag rgya chen po zer/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa de dgag pa ni/ 'di don brtags na 'di ltar mthong / /so mar bzhag na bal nyid yin/ /skud par byas na bcos par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di la dpe skyon yod/ /don gyi skyon yang 'di ltar mthong / /gol sa gsum po bcad tsam gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por 'gyur na ni/ /nyan thos 'gog pa'ang der 'gyur ro/ /shor sa bzhi po spangs snyam pa'i/ /rnam rtog phyag rgya chen po min/ /rtog pa med na spong mi nus/ /rtog pa med kyang spong nus na/ /sems can kun la 'bad med par/ /phyag rgya chen po cis mi skye/ /des na phyag rgya chen po nyid/

/yin na shor sa gol sa med/ /yod na phyag rgya chen po min/ /de skad bdag gis bsgrags pa la/ /rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams 'khro/ /khro ba de dang bdag gang bden/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa rtogs bya spros bral gyi lta ba la zhu ba la/ theg pa rim dgur 'dod pa la zhu ba/ gsung rab thams cad nges don kho nar 'dod pa la zhu ba/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i snying po nges don du 'dod pa la zhu ba/ bshad bsgom bsngo ba sogs la yod med sogs kyi mthar 'dzin 'dod pa la zhu ba dang bzhi'i/ dang po theg pa rim dgur 'dod pa la zhu ba ni/ theg pa rim dgu'i rnam gzhag gi /'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la/ /rgyud sde'i rnam dbye mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo phal cher bdag sun 'byin/ /'di yang gang bden gang rdzun pa/ /'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa gsung rab thams cad nges don kho nar 'dod pa la zhu ba ni/ kha cig sangs rgyas gsung rab ni/ /rtog pa med kyang spong nus na/ /nges don cig pu kho na yin/ /dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs med/ /ji bzhin ji bzhin ma yin pa'i/ /sgra yang gnyis su gsung pa med/ /gal te gsung na sangs rgyas kyang / /rdzun gsung bar ni thal 'gyur zhes/ /bdag gis drangs don nges don la/ /sogs pa'i rnam gzhag legs par bshad/ /de la'ang sde snod mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo 'ga' zhig bdag la rgol/ /gang bden khyed kyis gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i snying po nges don du 'dod pa la zhu ba ni/ khyed kyi bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ /kha cig nges pa'i don du bshad/ /bdag gis drangs pa'i don du ni/ /lung dang rig pas bsgrubs te bshad/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa bshad bsgom bsngo ba sogs la yod med sogs kyi mthar 'dzin 'dod pa la zhu ba ni/ khyed kyis chos rnams dbu mar gsungs/

/yod dang med dang mthar 'dzin bkag /khyed kyis gsung bzhin bdag gis kyang / /'chad pa'i tshe 'ang yod med bkag /gnas lugs bsgom na yod med grol/ /bsngo ba'i tshe na'ang yod med 'das/ /yod 'dzin la ni mtshan ma yi/ /dug can yin zhes khyod kyis gsungs/ /des na bdag gi bshad pa dang / /sgom pa dang ni bsngo ba yang / /yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug /spangs pa'i cho ga dug med bgyis/ /de la mu stegs grangs can dang / /nyan thos thams cad yod smra'i lugs/ /'dod pa de dag bdag la rgol/ /'di dag kyang ni bden mi bden/ /khyed kyis rnam par phyes te gsungs/ /zhes pas bstan/ ༈ /lnga pa sa lam la zhu ba la/ gnas skabs kyi sa lam la zhu ba dang / mthar thug gi sa lam la zhu ba gnyis kyi/ dang po gnas skabs kyi sa lam la zhu ba ni/ sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ /'ga' zhig sa lam mi dgos zer/ /la la gsang sngags phar phyin gnyis/ /mthun pa dang ni mi mthun pa'i/ /rnam dbye phal cher 'khrul par mthong / /ma 'khrul ba yi rnam gzhag la/ /mdo rgyud rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /cha mthun khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /phyi nang sa lam bdag gis bshad/ /u rgyan dzā lan dha ra dang / /gsang can tsa ri tra la sogs/ /phyi dang nang gi gnas chen rnams/ /sa bcu la sogs yin pa la/ /rgyud sde legs par ma bslab pa'i/ /blun po rnams kyis der ma go /des na sa lam mi bgrod par/ /yul chen tshol ba'i gang zag mang / /de dag khyon kyi gsung rab dang / /'gal bar mthong nas bdag gis bkag /de la'ang de 'dra'i rigs can rnams/ /bdag la rgyab kyis phyogs par snang / /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa mthar thug gi sa lam la zhu ba ni/ de bzhin sangs rgyas sa lam yang / /nyan thos phar phyin gsang sngags la/ /'ga' zhig mthun zhing 'ga' zhig la/ /mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag zab mo yod/ /blun po rnams kyis 'di mi shes/ /bdag gis khyed kyi gsung bzhin bshad/ /de la chags sdang can rnams khro/

/'di dag su dang su bden pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa tshig la zhu ba la/ /tshig gi sbyor ba la zhu ba/ /sgra bsgyur tshul la zhu ba/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la yid 'byung bstan pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po tshig gi sbyor ba la zhu ba ni/ tshig gi sbyor ba 'bad pa la/ /'bru mang po dang de'i skyes bu/ /ba gnyis pa dang bzlas dbye ba/ /gzhi mthun la sogs tshig sbyor ni/ /bdag gi sgra dang mthun par bshad/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sgra bsgyur tshul la zhu ba ni/ legs par sbyar la bod skad du/ /mkhas pas bsgyur ba thams cad dag /sgra mi shes pas bsgyur ba la/ /tshig don nor pa ci rigs mthong / /de 'dra bdag gis bcos nas bshad/ /ka cog sogs kyi bsgyur ba la'ang / /'ga' zhig sgra dang cung mi mthun/ /'ga' zhig don 'gyur dag tu byas/ /'ga' zhig brda rnying go ba dka'/ /'ga' zhig snga ma btsan par byas/ /la la gsar bcad dag gis bcos/ /la la rgya skad sor bzhag snang / /la la khams kyi bye brag gis/ /rgya skad gcig la'ang bshad tshul gyi/ /bod kyi sgra bsgyur tha dad snang / /'di 'dra tshig don 'dra mi 'dra/ /de dag legs par dpyis phyin pa/ /blun po rnams kyis lta ci smos/ /mkhas pa yis kyang shes par dka'/ /de dag bdag gis tha snyad la/ /sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis legs par shes/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa ngan pa'i spyod tshul la yid 'byung bstan pa ni/ 'on kyang skye bo chags sdang dang / /blun phyir bdag ni khyad du gsod/ /'di 'dra bdag gis shes mi shes/ /mgon po sras dang bcas pas mkhyen/ /'gro ba dam chos sun 'byin pa/ /de la 'jig rten phal cher bstod/ /bdag gis chos min sun phyung bas/ /'jig rten phal cher bdag la dmod/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten thugs brtse la/ /'jig rten phal cher rjes mi 'jug /slu byed me tog mda' can gyi/ /rjes su 'jig rten 'di dag 'brangs/

/kye ma bsod nams dman pa'i mi/ /lha skal chad pas 'byung po sgrubs/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa rjes kyi zhu ba la/ bden rdzun sangs rgyas la dpang du gsol ba dang / sangs rgyas nyid la gsol ba rtag tu btab tshul/ zhu ba'i spobs pa ji ltar skyes pa'i tshul dang gsum gyi/ dang po bden rdzun sangs rgyas la dpang du gsol ba la yang / don dngos dang / sngon 'byung gzhan bshad pa gnyis kyi/ dang po don dngos ni/ de ltar don dang tshig dag gi /'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la/ /lung dang rig pa mi 'gal bar/ /bdag gis dgag sgrubs bgyis pa la/ /'jig rten phal cher chags sdang gi /bsam pas bdag la dmod mod kyi/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /khyed ni bdag la dges par bsam/ /'phags pa klu sgrub 'di skad du/ /chos 'di de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /rtsod pa'i don du ma gsungs mod/ /'on kyang 'dis ni gzhan lta rnams/ /me yis bud shing bzhin du bsreg /ces gsungs pa de thog tu babs/ /bdag kyang gzhan la khyad sod pa'i/ /bsam pas bshad pa ma lags mod/ /'on kyang khyed kyi sde snod bzhin/ /bshad pas gzhan gyi chos lugs bsregs/ /thig skud drang por bzhag pa na/ /ya yo can rnams sems la zan/ /de bzhin khyed kyi gsung bsgrub pas/ /chos ltar bcos rnams mnyes ma gyur/ /bdag la chags sdang ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang bstan pa bsrung 'dod pas/ /bden par smra na pha rol khro/ /rdzun par smra na sdig pa lci/ /da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /thal sbyar nas ni don 'di zhu/ /bdag gi bden par smras lags sam/ /'on te rdzun par smra bar bgyi/ /gal te bden par smras na ni/ /brdzun par smra ba thams cad khro/ /de ste rdzun par smras na ni/ /khyod kyi gsung dang 'gal du dogs/ /gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung na ni/ /chos log thams cad sun dbyung 'tshal/ /'on te 'jig rten sems bsrung na/ /chos log la yang bstod 'tshal lo/

/bden par smras na gzhan sems bsreg /brdzun par smras na bstan pa 'jig /smra ba spangs na don mi rtogs/ /des na dam pa'i spyod pa dka'/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sngon byung gzhan bshad pa ni/ e ta zhes bya'i drang srong mchog /de yis gsod pa'i mchod sbyin bkag /de tshe sha la dga' ba yi/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsad ces grag /deng sang na yang yul de na/ /e ta sdab pa'i sha zhes zer/ /dam chos smra ba'i dge slong mchog /me tog zla mdzes thugs rje can/ /dam chos bshad pa'i le lan gyis/ /rgyal po'i chad pa bcad ces thos/ /gzhan yang bden par smras pa'i rgyus/ /smra ba po la 'jig rten kun/ /log par 'jug pa mang lags pas/ /thugs rje mnga' bas bskyangs du gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sangs rgyas nyid la gsol ba rtag tu btab tshul la/ sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo bla ma la gsol ba btab tshul/ 'dod don smos pa'i sgo nas slar yang gsol ba btab tshul dang gsum gyi/ dang po sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab tshul ni/ da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas sras bcas dgongs par zhu/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can rgud pa rnams la gzigs/ /bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /rnam pa kun tu byin gyis brlob/ /thun mong ba dang phul byung chos/ /rang gzhan don kun brnyes nas ni/ /sems can thams cad skyobs mdzad pa/ /ston mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo bla ma la gsol ba btab tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas/ /bdag gi 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad/ /yun ring dus nas 'di nyid ni/ /khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes/ /mkha' la de lta'i gsung bsgrags pa/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la sangs rgyas gsung rab bor/

/log lta'i mun pas khebs par yang / /yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes/ /rmongs pa phal cher gus pas bsten/ /skyon med yon tan dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin sgrub pa yi/ /bla ma dam pa brnyed na yang / /'jig rten 'di dag dad pa nyung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /so so'i skye bo'i skur bstan pa/ /bdag gi legs par shes bzhin du/ /de lta na yang bdag rmongs pas/ /mthong yang rnam pa thams cad du/ /ma mthong ba dang 'dra bar gyur/ /las kyi bag chags shin tu sra/ /khyod kyi bdag la dbang bskur ba/ /de tshe som nyi med par gyur/ /gsung rab mchog la spyis phyag 'tshal/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba na/ /mgon po khyod kyi gsung rab mchog /nan tan gyis ni bka' bstsal pa/ /'bad pas ci nus bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos de grol/ /de nas ji skad gsung pa yi/ /bka' stsal de dag ci gsung bzhin/ /rnam pa kun du thog tu babs/ /bden gsung khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa 'dod don smos pa'i sgo nas slar yang gsol ba btab tshul la yang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa gshegs par gsol ba/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal can la gzigs par gsol ba/ yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung bar gsol ba/ ma bcol phan pa byed pa'i dpe gzhan gyi sgo nas gsol pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa gshegs par gsol ba ni/ las kyi chu bos gdams pa na/ /sems la rang dbang thob pa dka'/ /des na sdig pa'i dbang gyur pa'o/ /nyes pa bkru ba'i 'jug ngogs mchog /'jig rten mgon pos gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la thal sbyar gus btud de/ /rkang gi khong nas 'jigs sems kyis/ /sdig pa de dag thams cad ni/ /yang nas yang du bshags par 'tshal/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdig pa yi/ /sa bon drung nas dbyung du gsol/

/zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa 'bras bu sdug bsngal can la gzigs par gsol ba la yang / 'gro ba spyi la gzigs par gsol ba dang / /bye brag so so la gzigs par gsol ba gnyis kyi/ dang po 'gro ba spyi la gzigs par gsol ba ni/ thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs ldan pa/ /mgon po yud tsam dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba shes rab mig dang bral/ /yid gtad byams pa'i grogs kyis bslus/ /nyams nga'i lam du rnam par 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal khur gyi shin tu non/ /phyogs kun dgra bos khebs pas na/ /kha skam mig rtsa zhan gyur pa/ /sdug pa'i smre sngags sna tshogs 'don/ /mgon med skyabs kyang ma mchis pa/ /'jig rten 'di la gzigs su gsol/ /khyod kyi dang po 'di skad du/ /nga ni mgon med khyed cag gi /mgon du gyur zhes gsungs pa gang / /thugs dam brtan pa'i thugs rje can/ /de la mgon med bdag cag skyabs/ /las kyi shugs kyis bzlog dka' ba'i/ /sdug bsngal chu bo shin tu 'jigs/ /mgon po bdag cag bsgral bar zhu/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bye brag so so la gzigs par gsol ba la yang / mi'i 'gro ba la gzigs par gsol ba/ ngan song gi 'gro ba la gzigs par gsol ba/ lha dang lha min la gzigs par gsol ba dang gsum gyi/ dang po mi'i 'gro ba la gzigs par gsol ba ni/ da dung bdag la zhu ba mchis/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas gzigs su gsol/ /ma ga dha dang ko sa la/ /bde pa la dang yangs pa can/ /phal rgyal dang ni 'khor mo 'jig /ser skya'i grong khyer la sogs pa/ /yul 'di'i gtsug lag khang dang ni/ /sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin rnams dang / /khyed kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /sems can rnams kyi bde sdug la/ /re zhig gzigs pa mdzad du gsol/ /u rgyan dzā lan dha ra dang / /kong ka na dang sin dhu'i yul/ /kha che dang ni kha sha sogs/ /ma ga dang ni li yi yul/ /de bzhin hor dang hor chen po/ /hwa la shan dang nye ba'i ljongs/

/rgya nag rgya nag chen po dang / /gan dha ra dang 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /zang gling dang ni gser gyi gling / /zla ba'i gling dang seṅge'i gling / /bhaṃ ga bha ran+t+ra la sogs/ /lho dang nub na gnas pa'i ljongs/ /sngon ni khyod kyi bstan pa'i gzhi/ /kha ba can gyi byang phyogs yul/ /thub pas bod dang bod chen ces/ /yongs su bsgrags pa'i sa phyogs 'dir/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /lo ni nyis stong lnga brgya na/ /dam chos rgyas par 'gyur zhes gsung / /der ni dam chos 'dzin pa la/ /klog dang kha ton byed pa dang / /nyan dang bshad dang bsgrub pa yang / /nga yi spyan gyis gzigs so zhes/ /'gro mgon khyod kyis lung bstan bstan/ /de lta mod kyi da lta yi/ /skye bo 'di dag bsod nams zhan/ /dus kyang shin du snyigs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ /khyed kyi bstan pa chud kyang gsan/ /de yi stobs kyis sems can rnams/ /shin tu gnag dka'i sdug bsngal myong / /rngon pas gang pa'i ri dwags ltar/ /skrag pas mig rtsa rig rig po/ /'jigs pa'i dbang gis goms pa 'khyor/ /bkres pas lto ba rab tu rnyong / /rlung dang grang bas gdung ba'i lus/ /'ga' zhig nad kyis rnam par bcom/ /la la'i nye du 'grel pa brlag /'ga' yi lam yang rnam par bkag /'ga' zhig shes pa thom nas snang / /bsod zad rnams la gdon yang sdang / /sngon chad nyes par spyad pa yis/ /las ngan smin pa bdag cag la/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol/ /mi yi 'jig rten tho ris zhes/ /khyod kyis bde 'gro'i bsngags pa mdzad/ /'on kyang mtho ris sdug bsngal 'di/ /mgon pos myur du skyabs 'tshal lo/ /gang la skyabs su mchis kyang ni/ /skyabs de dag gis slu bar mthong / /slu ba med pa skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa ngan song gi 'gro ba la gzigs par gsol ba ni/ sems can dmyal ba'i gnas la yang /

/thugs rje ldan pas yud tsam gzigs/ /yang gsos dang ni thig nag dang / /bsdus 'joms dang ni ngu 'bod sogs/ /mnar med srid pa bzod dka'i bar/ /mes bsreg mtshon cha'i char phab pas/ /nyams chung 'khun sgra 'byin pa tsam/ /sdug skad 'byin par mi nus pa/ /tsha ba'i sems dmyal rnams la gzigs/ /chu bur can sogs 'khyags pa yi/ /lus gas 'gul nyams ma mchis pa/ /'di 'dra'i sems dmyal ji ltar gos/ /mgon po yi dwags bkres skom gyis/ /gdung pas yun ring nyams thag pa/ /bza' btung 'dod pa'i cho nges can/ /'di la ji ltar bgyi ba gsungs/ /rtse ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dud 'gro'i gnas kyang gzigs su gsol/ /phan tshun bza' bas rnam par 'jigs/ /'ga' zhig bsregs te gsod pa mthong / /'ga' zhig bzung nas rgyu lto 'byin/ /'di la mgon po thugs rje mdzod/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa lha dang lha min la gzigs par gsol ba ni/ lha min lha yi gnas na yang / /mtho ris sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /thog mar bskyid sar bskyed bskyed nas/ /tha mar sdug bsngal gyis bcom ste/ /smre sngags 'don zhing ngan 'gror mchi/ /brtse ldan kun nas gzigs su gsol/ /sems can las la spyod pa la/ /khyed kyi thugs rje mi 'jug na/ /'gro ba bde bar gnas pa la/ /khyed kyi thugs rje 'jug lags sam/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas rjes su gzung bar gsol ba ni/ sman pas nad pa gso ba dang / /mgron po dag la skyel ma dang / /long ba dag la dmigs bu dang / /phongs pa dag la sbyin bdag dang / /gsod par nges la'ang skyob pa mthong / /blun zhing snying rje shas chung ba/ /nus pa med pa'i skye bo yang / /'gro la phan phyir de 'dra yis/ /phan par brtson par bgyid lags na/ /khyod ni zhi ba thams cad mkhyen/ /brtse bas sems can kun phan bzhed/ /nus pa dpag tu med mchis pa/ /des na phan dgongs mdzad par rigs/

/'gro ba las kyi rnam smin la/ /spyod phyir phan par mi nus na/ /dang po las la 'jug pa nyid/ /mgon po khyod kyis cis mi 'gegs/ /de yang dgag par mi spyod na/ /nga ni thams cad mkhyen pa zhes/ /'khor gyi nang du seṅge'i sgra/ /bsgrags pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar lags/ /'di 'dra'i skabs su mu stegs dang / /bdud kyi phyogs rnams rgol na ni/ /de la chos dang mthun pa'i lan/ /bdag gis ji ltar gdab par bgyi/ /khyod ni byams dang snying rje sogs/ /tshad med bzhi yi thugs dang ldan/ /lha yi mig dang rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /mngon shes drug po thogs mi mnga'/ /de slad byams sogs kyis bskyangs te/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni ces mi 'dul/ /gdug pa can la rgyal sras kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni ma bsdigs na/ /nyes pa yin zhes khyod kyis gsungs/ /cho 'phrul gsum la mnga' 'byor pa/ /khyed la nyes 'di mi mnga' na/ /rgyal sras rnams la'ang mi mtshungs sam/ /gal te 'ga' zhig ji skad gleng / /stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa khyod/ /bdud kyi stobs kyang 'joms mdzad na/ /stobs chung rnams la gzhan 'tshe ba'i/ /stobs 'di khyed kyis cis mi 'joms/ /dbang bcu dag la dbang mdzad pa'i/ /mgon pos 'gro kun skyobs mdzad na/ /'gro ba dbang med 'di dag la/ /khyod kyi dbang 'byor ji ltar lags/ /med pa yongs su sprul pa dang / /yod pa gzhan du bsgyur ba sogs/ /yongs su dag pa bzhi ldan pa/ /khyed kyi 'phrin las dus la babs/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa sel mdzad pa/ /'di ltar phongs pa gzigs nas ni/ /ting 'dzin de la 'jug tu gsol/ /khyod kyi thugs rje chen po yis/ /'jig rten kun la lan drug gzigs/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid kyang / /'gro ba'i don la rtag tu dgongs/ /khyod ni nyon mongs mi mnga' ba/ /rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs 'joms/ /da lta'i 'gro ba nyon mongs pa/

/'joms phyir khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu brnyes khyod kyi/ /'phrin las 'bad pa ci zhig 'tshal/ /de slad bdag cag rjes su zungs/ /'jigs pa med pa'i chos bzhi brnyes/ /mu stegs gzhan gyis mi rdzi bas/ /'khor du seṅge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /'jig rten kun la gsal bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /drug phrag gnyis dang gsum gnyis ldan/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bla ma khyod la bdag gsol 'debs/ /ji ltar legs par bzung du gsol/ zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa ma bcol phan par byed pa'i dpe gzhan gyi sgo nas gsol ba la yang / ma bcol phan byed kyi dpe gzhan smos pa dang / sangs rgyas nyid la rjes su gzung bar gsol ba dngos dang gnyis kyi/ dang po ma bcol phan byed kyi dpe gzhan smos pa ni/ khyab 'jug 'jig rten phan 'dod pas/ /dga' byed dga' byed dgra sta can/ /mi yi seṅge mi thung sogs/ /rnam par 'phrul pa du ma yis/ /chos min byed pa'i gdug pa can/ /'bad pa chen pos btul zhes grag /des ni 'phags pa'i chos ma thob/ /byang chub sems kyang ma bskyed mod/ /'on kyang phan pa'i spyod pa 'di/ /mgon po chen pos gzigs su gsol/ /brgya byin gtsug na zla ba dang / /phyag gi snying po byin za'i bdag /nor lha klu rgyal ma dros pa/ /nor rgyas rgya mtsho'i rgyal po sogs/ /de dag 'phags pa'i chos ma thob/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje med/ /de lta mod kyi rang rang gi /nus pa bzhin du gzhan la phan/ /nyi zla gza' skar ma bcol yang / /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor gdul ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyi bskor/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sangs rgyas nyid la rjes su bzung bar gsol ba dngos ni/ mi yi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu'i rol mdzad sna tshogs mdzad/ /dka' thub dka' ba sun dbyung phyir/ /khyod kyi lo drug dka' ba spyad/

/rgyal po zas gtsang sngon rab kyis/ /mgu mdzad khams drug bshig nas btul/ /rgyal po chen po pi lin yang / /'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis btul/ /rgyal po u tra ya na ni/ /khyod sku ri mor bris pas btul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /lha dang bcas pa'i bdud kyi sde/ /btul nas chos kyis grol bar mdzad/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi sdig /ras yug chen po'i gdams pas sbyangs/ /dge sbyong dgra bcom 'gro ba dag /dmyal bar bskur nas phyis nas gso/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen gyis/ /dbang phyug chen po bsad nas btul/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams bsdigs nas btul/ /lha mo nam gru bstod pas btul/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang / /rigs sngags sbyor ba'i cho ga dang / /ril bu sman gyi sbyor ba yis/ /sdug bsngal can rnams legs par gsos/ /de bzhin rgyal sras thugs rje can/ /cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'dul mdzad pa/ /de dag kun gyi 'jig rten 'di/ /bu gcig bzhin du bskyangs zhes grags/ /mnyan yod la sogs gdul dka' ba/ /'dul phyir shā ri'i bu la sogs/ /nyan thos chen po bsngags pa mdzad/ /rigs dang bya phyir 'char ka dang / /yul gzhan rgyal po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'phags pa ka ta ya na sogs/ /gang la gang gis 'dul gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis thams cad btul/ /de lta'i 'phrin las bsam yas pa/ /mthong ngam thos par gyur na yang / /su zhig ngo mtshar mi skye 'gyur/ /sngon gyi 'phrin las de 'dra'i cha/ /da lta'i 'gro ba nyams thag cing / /mgon med 'dren pa ma mchis pa/ /glen cing phyogs kyang mi 'tshal ba/ /ri dwags rgya ru tshud 'dra ba'i/ /sems can rnams la mi gzigs na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs rje de/ /ji ltar lags pa gsung du gsol/ /sdug bsngal can la mi gzigs pa/ /khyed kyi thugs rje chen po gang / /nyams thag 'jigs pas gdams pa na/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi zhing 'bros/

/'bros pa de bar thugs rje yi/ /spyan ras gzigs kyang ci zhig skyon/ /sems can las la spyod pa la/ /khyed kyi phan par mi spyod na/ /'on kyang sdug bsngal can de la/ /bka' tsam bstsal na cir 'gyur lags/ /'jig rten pa dag ma phan yang / /sdug bsngal ldan pa'i sdug grogs bgyid/ /khyod kyi de yi cha tsam zhig /mdzad na'ang dbugs 'byin bgyid pa gsum/ /de lta na yang kun mkhyen khyed/ /bdag cag 'gro la mi gzigs na/ /da ni skyobs par byed pa yi/ /kye ma skyabs gzhan gang la bgyi/ /ji ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po dga'/ /thar pa bya phyir sprul pa brtson/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po sgyu ma yi/ /dpung gis 'jigs pa kun las sgrol/ /mgon po khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'jigs pa kun las bsgral du gsol/ zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa zhu ba'i spobs pa ji ltar skyes pa'i tshul ni/ mgon khyod kun la phan mdzad kyang / /bdud dang mu stegs dgra bzhin blta/ /lha sbyin legs pa'i skar ma sogs/ /slob mar gyur kyang rgyab kyis phyogs/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /kun mkhyen gyis kyang mi 'gu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas sems can don/ /sgrubs par 'dod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /na ba'i bu la khyad par du/ /ma ni gdung pa skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba sras bcas kyang / /dam pa min la khyad par brtse/ /de skad gsungs pa'i tshig 'khum pas/ /blun po bdag ni spobs pa skyes/ /bzhad gad mkhan gyi rgyal po la/ /ji ltar gleng kyang mi khro ba'i/ /khrims 'di chos ldan snga ma yi/ /'jig rten bde ba'i don du bcas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zlos gar la/ /khro rgyal thugs rje ldan pa yis/ /gnad du bskul nas sangs rgyas kun/ /nye bar byin gyis brlab ces gsungs/ /de ltar khum nas thugs rje can/ /mgon po khyod la yang dang yang / /mi shes bzhin du zhu ba'i 'phrin/ /bdag ni dpyi rdol skyed par gyur/ /de ltar zhu ba'i 'khrid yig 'di/

/gsan nas 'di yi 'phrin lan zhig /'gro la dngos su mi gsung yang / /'phrin gyis gdams par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa don de ldan gyi bstan bcos kyi mjug gi don la/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul tshul/ bsngo ba'i khyad par gzhan bshad tshul/ /bden rdzun 'gro la gsal bar zhu ba/ dge ba bsngo zhing mdzad byang smos pa dang bzhi'i/ dang po yan lag bdun pa 'bul tshul ni/ mgon po khyod kyi yon tan 'tshal/ /bka' drin yang ni dran zhing mchis/ /de slad zhing gi rdul rnyed kyi/ /lus btud nas ni spyis phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba nyid don bcas/ /lus dang bla na med pa yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchod par bgyi/ /las kyi rlung gis bdas pas na/ /sdig pa'i rgya mtshor bdag cag lhung / /de slad nyes pa spyad pa rnams/ /rnam pa kun du bshags par 'tshal/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i slob ma dang / /rang rgyal dang ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis mdzad pa yi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo / /'jig rten blun par gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mi mdzad/ /bdag cag lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams/ /chos gsung phyir na bskul bar gsol/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed dka' bar/ /bstan phyir mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa/ /de la 'jig rten gnas kyi bar/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol/ /bslu ba mi mnga' skyabs kyi mchog /srid pa'i 'jigs pa skyobs pa gsum/ /de la byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rnam pa kun du bdag skyabs mchi/ /'gro kun bde la dgod slad du/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag mchis te/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho spyad par bgyi/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /yod med 'dzin pa'i dug spang ste/ /'jam dpal ji ltar dges bsngo ba/ /de bzhin du ni bdag bsngo 'o/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa bsngo ba'i khyad par gzhan bshad tshul la/

gdul bya min pa sogs la'ang phan par smon pa/ sdig pa'i mun khung can la gzigs par gsol ba/ bdag nyid kyis 'gro kun bsgral bar smon pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po gdul bya min pa sogs la'ang phan par smon pa ni/ da dung bdag la bsngo ba'i tshul/ /sngon chad gzhan gyi ma bsam pa'i/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa skyabs pa'i phyir/ /skyobs pa mchog la bdag 'di zhu/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las mi 'da' zhes/ /khyed kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa mtshar/ /de la rjes su yi rang ngo / /gang dag khyod kyi gdul bya min/ /de yi drung du bdag song ste/ /rnam 'phrul bye bas yid bsgyur nas/ /khyod kyi bstan la 'jug par shog /gang zhig so sor ma brtags pa'i/ /btang snyoms khyod la mi mnga' mod/ /so sor brtags nas btang snyoms su/ /'jog pa khyod kyi gsung las 'byung / /khyod kyis btang snyoms bzhag pa yi/ /'gro ba de dang de dag la/ /bdag gi 'bad pa chen po yis/ /khyod kyi gdul byar 'gyur bar bgyi/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen khyod kyis/ /gnas ma yin la 'phrin las bzlog /de yi mdun du bdag song ste/ /chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar bgyi/ /las ni bdag gir bya 'o zhes/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba mi zad pa/ /de la thabs mkhas thugs rje dang / /ldan yang gso bya min ces gsungs/ /khyod kyis gso bya ma yin pa/ /de dag drung du bdag song ste/ /sdug bsngal skyabs par mi nus kyang / /de yi sdug grogs byed par shog /sems can rnams la phan dka' zhing / /phan par byas kyang mgu dka' mod/ /gal te phan par ma gyur kyang / /de la brtse bas ston par shog /ces pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa sdig pa'i mun khung can la gzigs par gsol ba ni/ nyi ma shin tu 'od gsal yang / /mig dang bral la gsal mi 'gyur/ /rin chen 'byung khung bzang po yang / /'bad rtsol med par thob pa dka'/ /phan par byed pa'i sman pa la/ /'byung pos zin pa shin tu khro/

/thugs rje mnga' ba khyod bzhugs kyang / /sdig can rnams kyis mthong ba dka'/ /rang nyid mun khung bzhugs nas ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od la 'khang pa ltar/ /de bzhin sdig pa'i khung bzhugs nas/ /phan mdzad khyed la 'khang par zad/ /de 'dra'i blun po gzigs nas ni/ /mgon po rnam 'phrul bye ba brgyas/ /re re'i mdun du bskor nas ni/ /de dga' ba yi chos bstan nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa bdag nyid kyi 'gro kun bsgral bar smon pa ni/ bdag kyang khyod kyi ma bsgral ba'i/ /'gro ba gang dag mchis pa de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las pas/ /lhag par gyur nas don byed shog /ces pas bstan// ༈ //gsum pa bden rdzun 'gro la gsal bar zhu ba ni/ bdag gis zhu ba'i 'phrin yig 'di/ /ma brjod kyang ni thugs la gsal/ /'on kyang sems kyi zug rngu'i tshogs/ /gsal phyir khyed la 'phrin 'di zhus/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i chos smra ba/ /bden par smras na phal cher khro/ /rdzun pas sdig tu 'gyur dogs pa/ /de dag gi yang 'phrin yig lags/ /bdag kyang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang khyed kyi thugs kyis rjes bzung bas/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dad pa'i blo gros skyes/ /de lta mod kyi khyed kyi gsung bsgrubs pas/ /skye bo phal cher mnyes par ma gyur ba/ /'di la dgongs la khyed kyis gang bden pa/ /rnam par phye la 'gro la gsal bar mdzod/ /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //bzhi pa dge ba bsngo zhing mdzad byang smos pa la/ dge ba bsngo ba dang / mdzad byang smos pa gnyis/ dang po dge ba bsngo ba la yang / rang don du bsngo ba dang / gzhan don du bsngo ba gnyis kyi/ dang po rang don du bsngo ba ni/ bdag kyang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / /yang dag bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing / /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur bar mdzod/

/zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa gzhan don du bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis legs par gang bsgrubs pa/ /yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug spangs te/ /kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i rtsa lag thob par shog /zhes pas bstan// ༈ //gnyis pa mdzad byang smos pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'phrin du zhu ba/ sde snod 'dzin pa dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /shu bhaṃ/ zhes pas bstan// ༈ //e ma phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang de sras la/ /zhu 'phrin pho nyar lnga rig dam pa'i chos/ /kun gyi ngang tshul 'dzin pa'i gtam gyis skyes/ /smra 'di 'jam dbyangs mgrin brgya'i nga ro bzhin/ /'di ni dag byed chos kyi gnad ma lus/ /gsal bar rdzogs pa'i rnam dpyod ri dwags mig /don ldan tshig gi sna rgyan 'gram par 'chang / /legs bshad rdzogs ldan dpal gyis sa gsum dge /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la zhu 'phrin gyi bsdus don khog phub 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gsar ba 'di yang / snyigs dus kyis bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras dam pa rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ snyigs dus gyi thams cad mkhyen pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs/ yongs 'dzin bslu med du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa lnga rig dam pa'i chos la blo gros kyi pad+ma kha cung zad phye ba/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rang gi yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu'i bsdus don zhig rtsom par bzhed pa'i gsung rab nyung ngu zhig mdzad 'dug par gzhi byas/ gzhung gi dbu zhabs yongs su rdzogs par/

sa spyad kyi 'phreng ba rnams spel te/ don 'grel khog phub zhib tu bstan pa 'di ni/ rang gi bgrangs gzhi bcu phrag drug dang nyag ma gsum du slebs pa sa mo phag lo zla ba gsum pa'i dmar cha rak+ta bzhad pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog tshom dmar du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rang dang nye bar gnas pa byams pa dpal 'byor gyis gus spro dang bcas bgyis so// ༈ //'di sbyar dge dang dus gsum legs byas kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slobs gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir bsam pa ma mus mthar phyin nas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slobs lhan cig sa paṇa bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /mngon dga'i zhing du thogs med legs bgrod de/ /sku mthong gsung thos spangs rtogs myur rdzogs nas/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa du ma yis/ /bstan pa spel zhing mthong thos dran reg kun/ /dag pa'i zhing der 'dren pa'i mthu ldan shog /de nyid de bzhin nyid du nges gyur nas/ /de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /phyogs dus kun du bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dge ba thams cad rgyas par gyur cig yi ge pa nor bu bkra shis yang rjes su 'dzin par shog/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu'i bsdus don khog phub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 27
